user.title: Connect Brandweerrooster
user.description: Sign in with your Brandweerrooster account. The integration uses the official Brandweerrooster API v2.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Brandweerrooster again
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} is no longer valid. Enter your current Brandweerrooster password.

profile.title: Station and first function
profile.description: Enter your details and create your first function (for example 'OvD West' or 'TS Echt'). Later you can add more functions with 'Add function', each with its own sensors.

data_description.incident_entity: Usually sensor.incidents from the FireServiceRota integration.
data_description.group_ids: An incident belongs to this function when one of these groups or tasks is in it. The first group names the station in the dispatch message.
data_description.turnout_mode: Choose 'Standby duty' for OvD or other standby duties. The function then gets a 'Piketdienst' switch: turn it on while you have duty. Alarms for this function only count as turnouts while the switch is on. Changing this rebuilds the statistics.
data_description.crew_min_size: For example 6 for a fire engine (1 commander, 1 driver, 4 firefighters) or 4 for a TS-4.

error.rate_limited: Brandweerrooster is temporarily rate limiting API requests. Wait a moment and try again.
error.name_exists: A function with this name already exists.
error.no_scope: Choose at least one group or task.

abort.already_configured: This Brandweerrooster account is already configured.

init.title: Brandweerrooster account
init.description: Settings for the whole account. Functions (groups, tasks, turnout counting) are changed on the function itself: ⋮ → Reconfigure, or add one with 'Add function'. Placeholders for the dispatch message: {placeholders}. A line with an empty placeholder is left out automatically.

data.brandbase: Look up vehicle names on Brandbase

data_description.brandbase: Looks up the vehicles of the P2000 alert on brandbase.hetbrandweerforum.nl (for example 23-5331 → TS Echt). Only regions from your own alerts, at most once a week.
data_description.vehicle_names: Only needed when you want a different name than Brandbase gives. One per line, for example: 235331 = TS Echt. Lines starting with # are ignored.
data_description.install_blueprints: Puts the bundled blueprints (notification, night alarm, dispatch message) under Automations → Blueprints.

error.vehicle_invalid: These lines are not a valid 'number = name': {details}

incident_entity_missing.title: FireServiceRota incident sensor not found
incident_entity_missing.description: Brandweerrooster ({title}) listens for incidents from {entity_id}, but that entity does not exist. Install the FireServiceRota integration, or pick the right sensor under Settings → Devices & services → Brandweerrooster → Configure.

entry_not_loaded.message: No loaded Brandweerrooster configuration was found.

generate_message.name: Generate dispatch message
generate_message.description: Builds the dispatch message for the latest incident and returns it as a response, so an automation can send it.

config_entry_id.name: Configuration
config_entry_id.description: Which Brandweerrooster configuration (optional; defaults to the first).

template.name: Template
template.description: Optional alternative template for this message only.

functie.name: Function
functie.description: Which function (optional; defaults to the function with the latest incident).

refresh_incident.name: Refresh incident
refresh_incident.description: Fetches the latest incident from Brandweerrooster again.

config_entry_id.name: Configuration
config_entry_id.description: Which Brandweerrooster configuration (optional; defaults to all).

resync_statistics.name: Resynchronise statistics
resync_statistics.description: Reads the full incident history again (slowly, in the background).

config_entry_id.name: Configuration
config_entry_id.description: Which Brandweerrooster configuration (optional; defaults to all).

options.duty: Standby duty: alarms count while the 'Piketdienst' switch is on (OvD/standby)
